description.en: The characteristic aircraft shape at the time of rollout is reproduced with new molded parts.

description.en: The aircraft color based on white and light gray is reproduced with molded colors, and a new MarkingSeal is included.

description.en: ● Faithfully reproduce the aircraft details with new parts.

description.en: Gundam's head, chest duct, arms, waist, and legs when rolled out are reproduced with new molded parts.

description.en: Instead of a V-shaped antenna, the head is equipped with the same type of head antenna as Guncannon's earliest model.

description.ja: ポージングの幅を広げるオプションパーツがセット
description.en: Optional parts are included to expand the range of poses.
